description: This Java class 'EntityActionTriggerProcessor' implements logic for processing notification rule triggers related to entity actions (add, update, delete) within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for filtering triggers, constructing notification info, and specifying trigger type.

classes.name: EntityActionTriggerProcessor
classes.description: A service class that processes entity action triggers for notification rules, including filtering triggers and constructing notification information.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Determines if a given trigger matches the specified trigger configuration based on action type and entity type.

methods.name: constructNotificationInfo
methods.description: Builds a notification info object containing details about the entity action trigger, such as entity ID, name, action type, and user info.

methods.name: getTriggerType
methods.description: Returns the type of trigger, which is ENTITY_ACTION.
